permittedAction: In the exact fresh SYS-003 frontend worktree, implement and prove only the two default-off HRIS presentation adapters for /hr/settings/workflow and /hr/team/delegation over SHARED-API-005, SHARED-API-006 and SHARED-API-010 through SHARED-API-012; commit and push only the exact frontend module branch. The backend worktree is read-only verification evidence.

freshWorktreePolicy.carrierRule: This token is carried after the pinned frontend commit. Do not merge or cherry-pick its carrier into either module worktree; copy the immutable token as dispatch evidence only.

ownerAuthorizationContract.centralAdmission: HCM route aliases and any product-authorization v51 projection remain central-control work after module result evidence; the module may not write them.

allowed: Present existing Approval policy catalog and governed publish behavior in the HRIS settings layout.
Present existing Approval delegation list, create and revoke behavior in the HRIS team layout.
Translate HRIS URL tab and focus state into safe local presentation state.
Reuse existing owner clients, types, problem responses, idempotency and receipt semantics without semantic alteration.
forbidden: Any HRIS-specific approval, workflow, policy or delegation business state machine
Any copied or proxied Approval endpoint
Any duplicated Approval table, command receipt, outbox, authorization predicate or capability
Any synthetic trusted identity, tenant, role, duty, population, purpose, field or revision context
Any optimistic success that is not backed by the owner response or receipt
Any business completion or tenant activation claim

migration.stopCondition: If implementation requires persistence, stop and submit an exact touch manifest for independent review before requesting Platform V332 or Approval V59.

forbidden: backend source, tests or migrations under the present token
frontend architecture, application routes, generated product authorization and HRIS shell model or menu files
shared Approval API clients or Approval product workspaces without a successor boundary packet
central control evidence outside the exact SYS-003 module-result root
PAY-001, TIM-001 or any Batch01 slice

rollout.zeroCallRequirement: Feature absent, false or tenant unenrolled causes zero SHARED-API-005, SHARED-API-006, SHARED-API-010, SHARED-API-011 and SHARED-API-012 owner calls from the HRIS adapters.

verification.policy: Run the new SYS-003 adapter and workspace targets once; after a correction rerun only the smallest failed file or case. Run an existing reused-seam target only when that seam changed. Do not run a repository-wide suite per correction.
conditionalReuse: Run libs/shared-utils/src/api/approval-management-api.test.ts only if the shared policy-query client changes under a separately issued successor.
Run the smallest approval-api policy-publish or delegation frontend test only if that shared client seam changes under a separately issued successor.
Run no backend target unless the implementation report identifies a suspected owner regression; diagnosis remains read-only.

required: frontend module branch result commit and base lineage
all twelve acceptance results with source or targeted-test evidence
five SHARED API route and method seals
cross-product entitlement, duty, population, purpose, revision and SoD negative evidence
changed-path and no-recount manifest proving backend, migration and central-control paths unchanged

nonClaims: This token does not prove either HRIS workspace complete.
This token does not activate a feature or enroll a tenant.
This token does not authorize product-authorization v51 generation or an HCM route alias.
This token does not grant a migration lease or backend write authority.
This token does not merge any module result to dwp-dev or grant business completion credit.
This token does not authorize PAY-001 or TIM-001 source work.
invalidationConditions: A fresh worktree path, branch, base head, tree, upstream or clean state differs before the first edit.
Any hash-bound owner packet, central authorization, preflight or roadmap bytes change.
An existing Approval API cannot satisfy the sealed contract without owner semantic changes.
A backend, migration, shared Approval client, product-authorization, OpenAPI, Auth, Gateway, route or HRIS shell model change is required.
A second feature alias, copied API, duplicated persistence or synthesized trust context is introduced.
Feature enablement, tenant enrollment, dwp-dev merge, business completion credit or production release is attempted.
